calculating person-time??
```{r}
person_time <- function(time1, time2) {
  # start and end dates for active ABD seasons
  season_start <- mdy(c("07/01/2021", "07/01/2022", "07/01/2023"))
  season_end <- mdy(c("12/31/2021", "12/31/2022", "12/31/2023"))
  
  total <- rep(0, length(time1))
  
  for (i in seq_along(season_start)){
    # each person's entry and exit per season
    entry <- pmax(time1, season_start[i])
    exit <- pmin(time2, season_end[i])
    
    time_in_season <- ifelse(time2 > season_start[i] & time1<= season_end[i],
                             as.numeric(exit - entry), 0)
    total <- total + time_in_season
  }
  
  return(total)
}
```

formatting dataset/cleaning?:
```{r}
# want one line per person, include all their person-time (only active period)
data <- full %>% 
  # only take first event/one line per id
  group_by(PPID) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == {
    event <- which(Pos_All==1)
    if(length(which(Pos_All==1)) > 0) {
      event[1]
    } else {
      1
    }
  }) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # if pos_all == 0 did not experience event -- censored 
  mutate(Pos_All = ifelse(is.na(Pos_All), 0, Pos_All),
         Symp_Date = mdy(var6_symp_date),
         Time2 = if_else(Pos_All == 1 & Symp_Date < Exit_Date, Symp_Date,
                        Exit_Date)) %>% 
  relocate(c(Symp_Date, Time2), .after = Exit_Date) %>%
  # 22 had missing enrollment/exit dates...drop?
  filter(!is.na(Enrolm_Date)) %>% 
  # calculating person-time in days
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(entry = 0,
         exit = person_time(Enrolm_Date, Time2)) %>% 
  relocate(c(entry, exit), .after = record_id) %>% 
  # only including those who contributed person time
  filter(exit != 0) # omg 4461 children same as in paper yay
```
